import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEmbedding
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyTwistedKernel

/-!
# Base change of sections of the twisted Cartier kernel

An epimorphic Grassmannian evaluation makes the pushed quotient sequence
right exact. Pullback preserves that right exactness; canonical base change
for its middle and right terms then gives surjectivity for the kernel term.
This supplies the section-lifting input for relative generation in D2'.
The argument is the curve-divisor specialization of the exchange mechanism
discussed by Kleiman, *The Picard scheme*, subsection `sb:Q`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

private theorem epi_app_kernel_of_kernelComparisons
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Abelian A] [Abelian B]
    {F G : A ⥤ B} [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms] [G.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (α : F ⟶ G) {M N : A} (q : M ⟶ N)
    [Epi (kernelComparison q F)] [IsIso (kernelComparison q G)]
    [IsIso (α.app M)] [IsIso (α.app N)] : Epi (α.app (kernel q)) := by
  let e := kernel.mapIso (F.map q) (G.map q)
    (asIso (α.app M)) (asIso (α.app N)) (α.naturality q)
  have h : kernelComparison q F ≫ e.hom =
      α.app (kernel q) ≫ kernelComparison q G := by
    apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (G.map q))).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, e, kernel.mapIso_hom, kernel.lift_ι]
    rw [kernelComparison_comp_ι_assoc, kernelComparison_comp_ι]
    exact α.naturality (kernel.ι q)
  have he : Epi (kernelComparison q F ≫ e.hom) := inferInstance
  rw [h] at he
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_isIso _ _).mp he

namespace Scheme
namespace Modules

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- If a quotient is still epimorphic after pushforward, base change of its
kernel sections is epimorphic whenever the surrounding canonical comparisons
are invertible and pullback preserves the kernel. -/
theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_kernel_epi
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) {M N : X.Modules} (q : M ⟶ N)
    [Epi ((pushforward f).map q)]
    [IsIso (pullbackKernelComparison g' q)]
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M)]
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app N)] :
    Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app (kernel q)) := by
  let R := pushforward f
  let P := pullback g
  let Q := pullback g'
  let R' := pushforward f'
  haveI : PreservesLimits R :=
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).rightAdjoint_preservesLimits
  haveI : PreservesLimits R' :=
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').rightAdjoint_preservesLimits
  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} P :=
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  haveI : IsIso (kernelComparison q Q) := inferInstanceAs
    (IsIso (pullbackKernelComparison g' q))
  haveI : PreservesLimit (parallelPair q 0) Q := PreservesKernel.of_iso_comparison Q q
  have hR := (ShortComplex.exact_kernel q).map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel
    R inferInstance inferInstance
  have hP := hR.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel P
    (inferInstanceAs (Epi ((pushforward f).map q))) inferInstance
  haveI : Epi (kernelComparison q (R ⋙ P)) := hP.epi_kernelLift
  haveI : IsIso (kernelComparison q (Q ⋙ R')) := inferInstance
  exact epi_app_kernel_of_kernelComparisons (canonicalBaseChangeMap sq) q

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Canonical base change and the counit on the changed base control the
pullback of the original relative evaluation map. -/
theorem pullback_counit_epi_of_baseChange_epi
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules)
    [Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M)]
    [Epi ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app ((pullback g').obj M))] :
    Epi ((pullback g').map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M)) := by
  let e := (pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫ pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    (pullbackComp g' f).symm
  have h := mateEquiv_counit (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f') e.hom M
  have he : Epi ((pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app ((pullback g').obj M)) := by
    infer_instance
  change Epi ((pullback f').map
    ((mateEquiv (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f') e.hom).app M) ≫ _) at he
  rw [h] at he
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_epi (e.hom.app ((pushforward f).obj M)) _).mp he

end Modules

namespace DivFamily

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The kernel of the actual twisted quotient remains a line bundle over
every test scheme. -/
theorem twistQuotientKernel_isLocallyTrivial
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) (x : DivFamily π T) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)) := by
  let P := (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L
  have hP : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial P := hL.pullback _
  have hK : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial (kernel (normalizedQuotient x)) :=
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial.of_iso
      (kernelIsIsoComp (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π T.hom)).inv x.q).symm
      x.kerLocallyTrivial
  let e := Modules.tensorObjKernelIso P hP (normalizedQuotient x) ≪≫
    (kernelIsIsoComp (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor P).inv
      (Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) (normalizedQuotient x))).symm
  exact LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial.of_iso e (Modules.tensorObj_isLocallyTrivial hP hK)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The actual twisted Cartier kernel commutes with arbitrary changes of
test scheme, using flatness of the divisor quotient over its base. -/
noncomputable def twistQuotientKernelPullbackIso
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T T' : Over S}
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π T) (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    (Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).obj (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)) ≅
      kernel ((x.pullbackAlong ψ).twistQuotientMap L) := by
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have hM : ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom _ L inferInstance
  haveI : IsIso (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison (quotBaseMap π ψ)
      (x.twistQuotientMap L)) :=
    Modules.isIso_pullbackKernelComparison (quotBaseSquare π ψ)
      (x.twistQuotientMap L) (twistQuotientMap_epi L x) hM
      (x.twist_isFinitePresentation L hL) (x.twist_isCoherentSheafFlat L hL)
      (x.twistQuotientKernel_isLocallyTrivial L hL)
  refine asIso (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison (quotBaseMap π ψ)
      (x.twistQuotientMap L)) ≪≫
    kernel.mapIso _ _ (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ) L)
      (twistPullbackIso L x ψ hL) ?_
  apply (cancel_epi (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ) L).inv).mp
  simpa only [Category.assoc, twistPullbackIso_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] using
    twistPullbackMap_comp_twistQuotientMap L x ψ

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Base change of a bundle pulled from the original family is invertible
when both test objects are flat over the original base. The intervening map
of tests need not be flat. -/
theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullbackTwist_isIso
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T T' : Over S}
    [QuasiCompact π] [QuasiSeparated π] [Flat T.hom] [Flat T'.hom]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsQuasicoherent] (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (quotBaseSquare π ψ)).app
      ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L)) := by
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom) L
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T'.hom)).app L) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T'.hom) L
  let a := (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ) ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
    (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map
      ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)
  let b := (canonicalBaseChangeMap (quotBaseSquare π ψ)).app
    ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L)
  let c := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T'.hom)).map
    (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ) L).hom
  haveI : IsIso a := inferInstance
  haveI : IsIso c := inferInstance
  have h : IsIso (a ≫ b ≫ c) := by
    change IsIso (((pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
      (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map
        ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)) ≫ _)
    rw [Category.assoc, canonicalBaseChangeMap_quotBaseSquare_comp]
    infer_instance
  exact (isIso_comp_right_iff b c).mp ((isIso_comp_left_iff a (b ≫ c)).mp h)

set_option maxHeartbeats 5000000 in
-- The canonical comparisons traverse several pullback and sheafification carriers.
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Surjective Grassmannian evaluation gives surjective canonical base change
of the actual twisted Cartier kernel's relative sections. Both test objects
may be arbitrary schemes over the field, and their connecting map need not
be flat. -/
theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_twistQuotientKernel_epi
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {π : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π T) (ψ : T' ⟶ T)
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L)) :
    Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (quotBaseSquare π ψ)).app
      (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L))) := by
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have hM : ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom _ L inferInstance
  haveI : (x.twist L).IsFinitePresentation := x.twist_isFinitePresentation L hL
  haveI : (x.twist L).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI : Epi (x.twistQuotientMap L) := twistQuotientMap_epi L x
  haveI : Epi ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
      (x.twistQuotientMap L)) := by
    exact @epi_of_epi _ _ _ _ _
      ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map (x.twistQuotientMap L)) hEpi
  haveI : IsIso (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison (quotBaseMap π ψ)
      (x.twistQuotientMap L)) :=
    Modules.isIso_pullbackKernelComparison (quotBaseSquare π ψ)
      (x.twistQuotientMap L) inferInstance hM inferInstance
      (x.twist_isCoherentSheafFlat L hL) (x.twistQuotientKernel_isLocallyTrivial L hL)
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (quotBaseSquare π ψ)).app
      ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L)) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullbackTwist_isIso L ψ
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (quotBaseSquare π ψ)).app (x.twist L)) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
      (quotBaseSquare π ψ) (x.twist L) (twist_isFiniteSupport_of_curve L hL x)
  exact Modules.canonicalBaseChangeMap_kernel_epi (quotBaseSquare π ψ)
    (x.twistQuotientMap L)

set_option maxHeartbeats 5000000 in
-- Transporting the counit through the kernel pullback iso expands both adjunctions.
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- If the changed divisor family has a generated twisted kernel, surjective
Grassmannian evaluation makes the pullback of the original kernel's relative
evaluation epimorphic. This combines section lifting with actual kernel
base change and the adjunction's canonical mate identity. -/
theorem pullback_twistQuotientKernel_counit_epi
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {π : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π T) (ψ : T' ⟶ T)
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T'.hom)).counit.app
        (kernel ((x.pullbackAlong ψ).twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    Epi ((Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map
      ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app
        (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) := by
  let e := twistQuotientKernelPullbackIso L hL x ψ
  let adj := Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π T'.hom)
  haveI : Epi (adj.counit.app (kernel ((x.pullbackAlong ψ).twistQuotientMap L))) := hgen
  have he : Epi (adj.counit.app
      ((Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).obj (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L))) ≫
        e.hom) := by
    have hn := adj.counit.naturality e.hom
    simp only [Functor.id_map] at hn
    rw [← hn]
    infer_instance
  haveI : Epi (adj.counit.app
      ((Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).obj (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :=
    (epi_comp_iff_of_isIso _ e.hom).mp he
  haveI : Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (quotBaseSquare π ψ)).app
      (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L))) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_twistQuotientKernel_epi L hL x ψ hEpi
  exact Modules.pullback_counit_epi_of_baseChange_epi (quotBaseSquare π ψ)
    (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L))

end DivFamily
end Scheme
end AlgebraicGeometry
